probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Editing video by editing the transcript What changes when you cut a video by deleting words instead of dragging clips. Chiara Mancini 29 September 2026 Video Text based editing sounds like a gimmick until you cut a forty minute interview in the time it takes to read it. How it works Rodaje transcribes the footage and lines the words up with the timeline. Delete a sentence and the clip goes with it. Move a paragraph and the video follows. The fine work still happens on the timeline, but the rough cut is done in the text. Where it falls short Music videos, b-roll heavy edits and anything without speech gain very little. Overlapping voices also confuse the transcript, so panels need a cleanup pass first. Getting clips out of it Once the long version is done, Taglio picks the moments worth posting and crops them for each platform. We still choose the final clips ourselves, but it finds most of the good ones. Tools in this post Rodaje Edit video by editing the transcript. Taglio Short clips from long videos, ready to post. M
